start.welcome:
✍️ *POSTFLOW*

👋 Hi *{user_name}*\!
Create, schedule, and publish posts\.

🔐 *Authorization*
• Status: {auth_status}

Choose an option below\.
start.unauthorized_suffix:
⚠️ *Your User ID:* `{user_id}`
Add it to `TELEGRAM\_USER\_ID` in `.env`\.

chatid.message:
🔑 *YOUR USER ID*

• User: {user_name}
• ID: `{user_id}`

Add it to `TELEGRAM\_USER\_ID` in `.env`\.

topics.menu:
🎯 *TOPIC PRESETS*

Manage your topic presets for AI post generation\.

📊 *Usage:* `{count}/{max}` topics

Choose an option below\.
topics.list_empty:
📋 *TOPICS LIST*

You don't have any topics yet\.
Add one to get started\!
topics.list_title:
📋 *TOPICS LIST*

Your topics \({count}/{max}\):

{topics}

Click on a topic to view details\.
topics.details:
🎯 *TOPIC DETAILS*

*Name:* `{name}`
*Created:* {created}

Use this topic when creating AI posts\.
topics.delete_empty:
🗑️ *DELETE TOPIC*

You don't have any topics to delete\.
topics.delete_select:
🗑️ *DELETE TOPIC*

Select a topic to delete:
topics.delete_confirm:
🗑️ *DELETE TOPIC*

Are you sure you want to delete:
`{name}`

This action cannot be undone\.
topics.delete_all_confirm:
🗑️ *DELETE ALL TOPICS*

⚠️ Are you sure you want to delete ALL topics?

This action cannot be undone\.
topics.add_prompt:
➕ *ADD TOPIC*

Enter a topic name \({min}\-{max} characters\):

Examples:
• `Python Programming`
• `AI & Machine Learning`
• `Tech News`

Type /cancel to abort\.
topics.added:
✅ *Topic Added*

Topic `{name}` has been added to your presets\.

You can now use it when creating AI posts\.
topics.ai_intro:
🤖 *AI GENERATION*

Select a topic preset or write a custom prompt:
topics.ai_custom:
🤖 *AI GENERATION*

Describe what you want to post\.
Example: `Thread on AI trends in 2026`

Type /cancel to abort\.
topics.openai_required:
⚠️ *Topics require OpenAI*

Topics are used for AI post generation\.
Configure `OPENAI_API_KEY` to use this feature\.
topics.max_reached_alert: ⚠️ Maximum topics reached! Delete one to add more.
topics.list_empty_alert: 📋 No topics yet. Add one to get started!

templates.menu:
🧩 *TEMPLATES*

Manage your reusable post templates\.

📊 *Usage:* `{count}/{max}` templates

Choose an option below\.
templates.list_empty:
📋 *TEMPLATES LIST*

You don't have any templates yet\.
Add one to get started\!
templates.list_title:
📋 *TEMPLATES LIST*

Your templates \({count}/{max}\):

{templates}

Click a template to view details\.
templates.delete_empty:
🗑️ *DELETE TEMPLATE*

You don't have any templates to delete\.
templates.delete_select:
🗑️ *DELETE TEMPLATE*

Select a template to delete:
templates.delete_confirm:
🗑️ *DELETE TEMPLATE*

Are you sure you want to delete:
`{name}`

This action cannot be undone\.
templates.delete_all_confirm:
🗑️ *DELETE ALL TEMPLATES*

⚠️ Are you sure you want to delete ALL templates?

This action cannot be undone\.
templates.add_prompt_name:
➕ *ADD TEMPLATE*

Enter a template name \({min}\-{max} characters\):

Examples:
• `Product launch`
• `Weekly update`

Type /cancel to abort\.
templates.add_prompt_content:
📝 *TEMPLATE CONTENT*

*Template:* `{name}`

Send the content for this template\.
Tip: long posts become threads\.
Type /cancel to abort\.
templates.edit_prompt:
✏️ *EDIT TEMPLATE*

*Template:* `{name}`

*Current content*
{content}

Send the updated content\.
Type /cancel to abort\.
templates.use_title:
🧩 *USE TEMPLATE*

Select a template to create a post:
templates.max_reached_alert: ⚠️ Maximum templates reached! Delete one to add more.
templates.list_empty_alert: 📋 No templates yet. Add one to get started!
templates.use_empty_alert: 📋 No templates yet. Add one to use templates.

stats.message:
📊 *STATISTICS*

*Overview*
• Total: `{total}`
• Published: `{published}`
• Scheduled: `{scheduled}`
• Draft: `{draft}`
• Failed: `{failed}`

*Performance*

status.message:

*Services*
• Bot: `{bot_status}`
• X: {twitter_status}
• OpenAI: {openai_status}
• Database: `{db_status}`

*Stats*

• Published: `{published}`
• Scheduled: `{scheduled}`

🕐 Last check: `{last_check}`

ai.prompt:
🤖 *AI GENERATION*

Describe what you want to post\.
Example: `Thread on AI trends in 2026`

Type /cancel to abort\.

posts.manual_prompt:
✏️ *WRITE POST*

Send your post text\.
Tip: long posts become threads\.
Type /cancel to abort\.
posts.image_use_new: 💡 Use /new to create a post with image\.
posts.image_caption_too_long: ❌ Caption too long\. Keep it under 280 chars\.
posts.image_data_missing: ❌ Image data missing\. Start again with /new\.
posts.image_prompt:
🖼️ *IMAGE POST*

Send an image with an optional caption\.
Caption must be 280 chars or less\.
Type /cancel to abort\.
posts.image_fetch_failed: ❌ Failed to fetch image from Telegram\.
posts.empty_content:
⚠️ *EMPTY CONTENT*

Write something to create the post\.
posts.empty_content_update:
⚠️ *EMPTY CONTENT*

Write something to update the post\.
posts.media_thread_blocked:
❌ *PUBLISH FAILED*

Media posts cannot be threads\.
posts.published:
✅ *PUBLISHED*

• Post ID: `#{post_id}`
• X post ID: `{tweet_id}`

🔗 [View on X]({tweet_url})
posts.thread_published:
✅ *THREAD PUBLISHED*

• Posts: `{tweet_count}`
• Post ID: `#{post_id}`

🔗 [View on X]({tweet_url})
posts.schedule_menu:
📅 *SCHEDULE POST*

Choose a time or enter a custom date\.
posts.custom_schedule_prompt:
📆 *CUSTOM SCHEDULE*

Format: `YYYY\-MM\-DD HH:MM`
Example: `2026\-02\-05 14:30`
Timezone: `{tz}`

Type /cancel to abort\.
posts.schedule_time_past: ❌ Scheduled time must be in the future\.
posts.reschedule_prompt:
📆 *RESCHEDULE POST*

Format: `YYYY\-MM\-DD HH:MM`
Example: `2026\-02\-05 14:30`
Timezone: `{tz}`

Type /cancel to abort\.
posts.delete_confirm:
⚠️ *CONFIRM DELETE*

This action cannot be undone\.
posts.edit_prompt:
✏️ *EDIT POST*

*Current content*
{content}

Send the updated text\.
Type /cancel to abort\.
posts.scheduler_unavailable: ❌ Scheduler service not available\. Restart the bot\.

preview.thread:
🧵 *THREAD PREVIEW*

*Summary*
• Posts: `{tweets}`
• Chars: `{chars}`
• Created: {created}
• Media: `{media}`

*Content*
{content}

Select an action:

scheduled.none:
📅 *NO SCHEDULED POSTS*

Create a post and choose Schedule to get started\.
scheduled.notify_success:
✅ *SCHEDULED {post_type} PUBLISHED*

Post `#{post_id}` is live

🔗 [View on X]({tweet_url})

drafts.none:
📝 *NO DRAFTS*

Create a post and save it as a draft\.

weekly.plan:
📆 *PLAN WEEK*

Select the days you want to publish:
Mon to Sun
weekly.posts_per_day:
📝 *POSTS PER DAY*

How many posts per selected day?
weekly.times_prompt:
⏰ *TIMES FOR {day_label}*

Enter {count} time slots as `HH:MM`, separated by commas\.
weekly.expired: ❌ Planning session expired\. Use /menu to start again\.
weekly.invalid_time_list: ❌ Invalid time list\. Use `HH:MM, HH:MM` with the correct count\.
weekly.invalid_day_selection: ❌ Invalid day selection\. Use /menu to start again\.
weekly.times_in_past: ❌ One or more times are in the past\. Enter future times\.
weekly.no_valid_times: ❌ No valid times to schedule\. Start again with /menu\.
weekly.scheduled_partial:
⚠️ *PARTIAL SCHEDULE*

Scheduled: `{scheduled}`
Failed: `{failed}`

Failed posts remain as drafts\.

conversation.cancelled:
🚫 *Cancelled*

Operation cancelled\.
Use /menu to start again\.

help.message:
ℹ️ *HELP*

*Commands*
• `/start` \- Welcome
• `/menu` \- Main menu
• `/new` \- New post
• `/plan` \- Plan week
• `/topics` \- Manage topics
• `/templates` \- Manage templates
• `/drafts` \- Drafts
• `/scheduled` \- Scheduled posts
• `/stats` \- Statistics
• `/status` \- System status
• `/settings` \- Settings
• `/chatid` \- Your user ID
• `/help` \- Help
• `/author` \- About the author
• `/cancel` \- Cancel

*Highlights*
• Manual or AI posts
• Topic presets for AI
• Templates for quick posts
• Scheduling
• Threads for long posts
• Stats overview
